description: This file defines a report parser class for generating analytic account balance reports in Odoo, including methods for retrieving account data, calculating sums, and generating report data.

classes.name: account_analytic_balance
classes.description: A report parser class for handling analytic account balance reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context and internal data structures.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child analytic accounts and their data.

methods.name: _get_objects
methods.description: Returns the collected account data objects, optionally reloading data.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches analytic line data for a given account and date range, summarizing balances and quantities.

methods.name: _move_sum
methods.description: Calculates sum of amounts (debit, credit, or quantity) for an account and date range.

methods.name: _move_sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance (debit minus credit) for an account over a date range.

methods.name: _sum_all
methods.description: Calculates total sums (debit, credit, or quantity) for a list of accounts over a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance (debit minus credit) for multiple accounts over a date range.
